text:
alex: Quick design check — noticed a weird state in the Invite flow when SSO is forced and the org has a pending audit export. Invite button becomes disabled but the tooltip just says "disabled". feels confusing.

maya: ugh yeah, saw that in the prototype. Tooltip needs to explain why and next steps. Maybe "Disabled while audit export in progress. Invite will be available after export completes."

oliver: Agree. Also the roles matrix modal gets cut off when the audit banner is present at the top — hits a11y keyboard trap issues when you try to tab through rows.

jia: @oliver can you share a screenshot? I remember the modal was anchored to the parent container and the banner changed the viewport offset.

oliver: paste: `screenshot.png` (attached) — you can see tab focus lands on the banner first and users can't reach the confirm button without arrow keys.

maya: For keyboard flow we should ensure modal traps focus inside it, and the audit banner should be `aria-live=polite` so it doesn't steal focus.

pm-ryan: From product side — we need clear copy for the disabled invite state. Proposed copy: "Invites temporarily paused while an audit export runs. You can continue managing roles — invites will resume after the export completes." Thoughts?

alex: Shorter suggestion: "Invites paused: audit export in progress. Try again in a few minutes." We want it easy to scan.

jia: Add an action link in the tooltip: "View export status" -> opens audit page anchor. That helps reduce support pings.

maya: +1 to action link. Also consider a small spinner inline so it's clear something is happening. Avoid large banners for this transient state.

oliver: Accessibility nit: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard (focusable) and announced by screen readers. Use `role=status` and link should be tabbable.

pm-ryan: Good call. On the roles matrix itself, can we collapse less-used permissions under a "More" toggle? Designers worried matrix is too dense for new admins.

maya: We prototyped a progressive disclosure for secondary perms last sprint. Let's reuse that pattern and test with 5 scenarios. Keeps primary roles visible and reduces cognitive load.

alex: One more thing: SSO toggle in org settings — the label currently reads "Enable SSO (recommended)". Legal asked we avoid "recommended" language. Suggest "Require SSO for this org" with a short helper text.

pm-ryan: Legal request noted. How about: label: "Enforce SSO" and helper: "When enabled, all new and existing members must authenticate via your SSO provider."

jia: UX question — if a customer flips to enforce SSO and they have non-SAML users, we need an explicit warning and a checklist before applying. Maybe a modal with the number of users affected and an export link for their invites.

maya: Yes — show "Users affected: 12" and buttons: "Export list" (secondary) and "Enforce SSO" (primary, destructive style). Include inline help: "This action may block current sessions."

oliver: Can we add an autosave of the current roles matrix snapshot before enforcement, so admins can roll back quickly? It ties into audit/log UX.

pm-ryan: That might be product-y heavy but worth a proposal for Dedicated/Private customers. For hosted, we can offer export snapshot.

maya: Action items: 1) Change invite-disabled tooltip copy + add "View export status" link (design + content) 2) Fix modal focus trap for roles matrix (eng) 3) Implement keyboard-accessible tooltip + aria roles (a11y) 4) Update SSO label and enforcement modal copy + checklist (product + design) 5) Consider roles progressive disclosure for density (design + research).

alex: I can make a short copy doc with alternatives and we can ship a quick patch for the tooltip. Who wants to pair on the modal focus fix?

oliver: I can take the modal focus work this sprint — will add to eng tickets.

jia: I'll wire the "View export status" link target and add analytics event.

pm-ryan: I'll sync with legal on SSO wording and confirm the enforcement flow for hosted vs dedicated.

design-bot: Reminder: design critique scheduled tomorrow 9:30am PT — bring prototypes and the screenshot. :memo:

alex: cool thanks everyone. catching up in the crit tomorrow.

maya: Added follow-up tasks to the board. :white_check_mark:
